items.title: Real-Time-Smoke-Fire-Detection-System
items.title_cn: 实时烟雾火灾探测系统
items.summary: This end-to-end Computer Vision application uses custom-trained YOLO11 weights to detect fire and smoke across multiple input sources, including images, videos, and live webcam streams.

items.comment: AI 领域新动态，保持关注，别被营销号带节奏。

items.title: Agentic Societies Need a Social Harness
items.title_cn: 代理社团需要社交线束
items.summary: An agentic society is a collection of AI agents that coordinate autonomously across trust boundaries, on behalf of different principals whose objectives may only partially align. We show experimentally that in agentic societies even honest, competent agents often fail to reach satisfactory outcomes ...
items.summary_cn: 代理社会是人工智能代理的集合，它们代表目标可能仅部分一致的不同委托人，跨越信任边界进行自主协调。我们通过实验表明，在代理社会中，即使是诚实、有能力的代理人也往往无法取得令人满意的结果...
items.comment: 法规来了，短期阵痛难免，长期看是行业走向成熟的必经之路。

items.title: ScienceBuddy: Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement for Interactive Scientific Agents
items.title_cn: ScienceBuddy ：交互式科学代理的递归递归自我改进
items.summary: We introduce and release ScienceBuddy, an interactive scientific research workspace that brings continually improving scientific agents into researchers' everyday workflows. ScienceBuddy supports researchers in carrying out scientific tasks while transforming their requests, feedback, and execution ...
items.summary_cn: 我们推出并发布ScienceBuddy ，这是一个交互式科学研究工作空间，将不断改进的科学代理引入研究人员的日常工作流程。ScienceBuddy支持研究人员执行科学任务，同时转变他们的请求、反馈和执行...
items.comment: 商业模型再升级，功能看着牛，钱包要捂紧。

items.title: PhysStream: Streaming Physics-Grounded Video Generation with Structured Scene Memory and Fine-Grained Motion Control
items.title_cn: PhysStream ：具有结构化场景内存和精细运动控制的流式物理接地视频生成
items.summary: Interactive control for video generation is moving from coarse prompts toward fine-grained, physically meaningful manipulation of dynamic scenes. Yet existing controllable methods either require the full control schedule before generation starts, or use pixel-space signals that dictate object positi...
items.summary_cn: 视频生成的交互式控制正在从粗糙的提示转向对动态场景进行细粒度、物理上有意义的操作。然而，现有的可控方法要么要求在开始生成之前进行完整的控制计划，要么使用指示对象位置的像素空间信号...

items.title: We don’t need AI regulation — leave safety to us, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says
items.title_cn: Nvidia的Jensen Huang表示，我们不需要人工智能监管—将安全问题留给我们
items.summary: AI isn't some new form of "alien mind," according to Jensen Huang. It's just hardware and software, so safety can be engineered by each AI product maker.
items.summary_cn: 根据Jensen Huang的说法，人工智能并不是“外星人思维”的新形式。它只是硬件和软件，因此每个人工智能产品制造商都可以设计安全性。
items.comment: 政策收紧，大厂合规团队又要扩编了，创新空间还剩多少？
